title: a render died inside the workflow: ComfyUI API error: HTTP 500 (09-22 00:05Z)
evidence: 3 ComfyUI execution error(s) in the last 24h; newest ComfyUI API error: HTTP 500 (09-22 00:05Z). The producer now NAMES this (Growth::ContentGenerator carries the ComfyUI error into the run's failure reason and the brain's decision row) instead of reporting every render death as a timeout, and it RE-SUBMITS once on a node exception (a fresh seed -- seed = the run's base seed + the new ComfyuiJob id -- so the retry draws a different sample). A retry that RECOVERS still leaves this failed row, so read this entry as 'the workflow can die on this input', not as 'a render was lost'. TWO classes land here and only one is the payload: (a) the workflow dying on its input -- an empty CLIPSeg head/hand mask reaching the WAS 'Bounded Image Crop with Mask' node, `index is out of bounds` (2026-09-21 11:16Z); (b) ComfyUI running out of VRAM mid-render, whose NEXT job then fails with the HTTP 500 seen here (2026-09-22 00:05Z). Class (b) is tracked with its budget numbers as `comfyui-torch-oom` -- read that entry for the cause instead of re-deriving it from this row. Neither is Rails code. Reconciled orphans are excluded.

2026-09-22 00:5xZ ops-triage: ROOT-CAUSE FIX landed for the 09-22 00:05Z pair. (The 11:16Z 'index is out of bounds' class is untouched -- that is the workflow's empty-CLIPSeg-mask payload, decided 17:5xZ as no-in-repo-fix.) DIAGNOSIS, from this install's own log: ComfyUI sizes its dynamic-VRAM budget from FREE memory, so the EMPTIER the card the MORE it loads. Job 7564 got 'loaded partially; 21719.11 MB usable, 21448.72 MB loaded, 1251.42 MB offloaded' (SDXL+CLIP still cached from stage 1) and died torch.OutOfMemoryError 78 MiB short at 21.32 GiB allocated on a 23.52 GiB device; the SAME workflow under ~8 GiB of co-tenants loaded '15275.11 MB usable / 7785.37 MB offloaded' and ran 'Prompt executed in 95.61 seconds'. Offloading is cheap here; over-committing is fatal. The OOM then broke ComfyUI's model state and the retry drew the HTTP 500 (Impact-Pack 'NoneType' has no attribute 'values'), so ONE over-commit = two failed jobs + a lost render. FIX (commit 6a01bb6): COMFY_LAUNCH_ARGS in bin/comfyui_harness.sh now passes --reserve-vram 5 (override COMFY_RESERVE_VRAM); it overrides EXTRA_RESERVED_VRAM (400 MiB default on Linux) AND aimdo's simple budget headroom, dropping ComfyUI's computed budget from ~21.7 GiB to ~17 GiB. VERIFIED offline: 'plan' prints launch_args=--listen 0.0.0.0 --reserve-vram 5; bin/comfyui_harness_test.sh 21/21 PASS (3 new assertions); tc_ops.py selftest 283 assertions / 0 failures; ComfyUI's own --help on this install accepts the flag; /proc/<pid>/cmdline assertion exercised on a live process. instrument_comfyui now asserts the launched process actually carries the flag and logs ERROR if a launch ever loses it. FALSIFIABLE PREDICTION for the next render: its log must read 'loaded partially; ~18000 MB usable' (not 21719) and reach 'Prompt executed in' with no torch OOM. Item stays probe-managed and self-closes 24h after the last error (00:05Z 09-23) if none lands; a fresh OOM re-fires here with fresh evidence.
